title: Perfect duality in a specified normalized coefficient presentation
statement: Let (C,J,R) be a ringed site with the independent site, morphism, coefficient and derived-category universes of def-weil-size-convention. Assume sheafification and locally-bijective characterization over the site and all its slices. For any site-perfect P in the unbounded module-sheaf derived category and any normalized RingedSiteDualityModel M [def-zl-ringed-site-duality-model], the canonical natural transformation N ↦ RHom(P,R) tensor N → RHom(P,N), defined by the specified evaluation transpose and symmetry of M, is invertible. The presentation M is fixed before P is chosen.

proof.text: Use the slice restriction comparison data and local-model criterion of the existing perfect-duality proof, now applied to the specified presentation M instead of choosing a presentation in the conclusion. The private restriction lemmas quantify over both presentations.

On a covering family choose bounded strict perfect representatives for P. The strict evaluation theorem and source-transport formula give invertibility of every restricted evaluation component. Exact slice restriction detects isomorphisms; symmetry converts to the left-ordered comparison, and componentwise invertibility gives invertibility of the natural transformation.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSitePerfectDualityForModel
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [∀ U : C, HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [∀ U : C, (J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R))]
    (P : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)))
    (hP : SheafOfModules.IsPerfectOnRingedSiteOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} R P)
    (M : RingedSiteDualityModel.{c, v, r, w} J R) :
    IsIso (ringedSiteDualEvaluationLeftNatTrans M.closed M.symmetric
      (ringedSiteDualityUnit.{c, v, r, w} J R) M.unitIso P)
